['Vossloh AG '].company_description: Vossloh AG is a rail technology company based in Werdohl, Germany. It is a global market leader for rail fasteners and switch systems, and in North America, it is the leading manufacturer of concrete railway ties. The company's customers include public and private railway companies, network operators, as well as regional and municipal transport companies. Since its restructuring, Vossloh has been focusing on target markets in China, the US, Russia, and Western Europe. The company has production sites in Germany, France, Luxembourg, Poland, and Scandinavia, as well as subsidiaries in Asia, North and South America, Australia, and Russia.
